name: toscana-pos
description: Toscana Ristorante — yerel ağda çalışan sipariş sistemi (garson, kasa, mutfak)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n sunucu,arayuz -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:create -w server && npm run db:generate -w server && npm run db:migrate -w server && npm run db:seed -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
